title: Stonetop Item (third-party content)
description: Frontmatter contract for an inventory/special item. Maps to Sled Dog's GearCatalogEntry. A bespoke custom move (if any) belongs in `note` for now.

name.description: Display name. Sled Dog derives the folder slug and namespaced key from it.

summary.description: One or two sentences on what this item is/does — shown on the party's Manage content page so owners know what they're adding.

label.description: Which add-gear group it appears under.

value.description: Relative Value 0–4 (see the Stonetop gear legend).

load.description: Load slots per unit; defaults to 1 when unset.

small.description: A small possession (circle slot, no Load).

uses.description: Consumable use-circles seeded onto the added item.

note.description: Clarifying note carried into the item's notes (also holds a custom move's text for now).

images.description: Optional images shipped to the party image gallery when this module is installed (a supporter feature). Files live beside this .md in the content repo; Sled Dog serves them from GitHub raw, pinned to the content commit.

file.description: Path to the image relative to this module folder (e.g. "art/homefront.png"). No leading slash, no "..".

caption.description: Short title shown on the gallery card.

description.description: Longer notes shown when the card is expanded.

url.description: A published Supabase public URL (paid packs). Alternative to `file`.

pack.description: For paid-pack content only: the pack slug this item belongs to.
